content:
maya_fin: FYI received INV-2025-08 for Q3 reserved commits — there's a capacity spike surcharge field 'surge_overage' for account HeliosLabs. Line shows ~$18,400, looks high. Anyone available for a quick recon?
samops: assigning to @lucy_billing and @devon_sales. Is this the same account that did the cross-region failover last month?
lucy_billing: on it, pulling meter tags now :mag_right: might be a tag attribution issue (region vs commit).
devon_sales: Helios says they only failed over for ~50 mins during maintenance, shouldn't be $18k. I can ask them to hold payment if we provisionally credit.
maya_fin: invoice metadata shows surge_overage aggregated from nodepool:dedicated-eu-west-3 and fallback:dedicated-us-east-1 — possible double-count on failover handoff?
invoicer-bot: Invoice INV-2025-08 generated. Lineitems: reserved_commit: 30000, surge_overage: 18400, sla_credit_applied: 0. Detected potential tag mismatch: host_tag != commit_tag for ~18% of burst usage.
lucy_billing: can you paste the billing API query you ran? I'll re-run with allocation slices.
lucy_billing: `GET /billing/allocations?account=helioslabs&start=2025-08-01&end=2025-08-31&group_by=nodepool,tag` returning entries where tag='failover' and tag='reserved-commit' overlap for the same request ids.
samops: if tags overlapped we may be double-billing. Reclassification will need finance approval to adjust invoice lines. @maya_fin can you flag for provisional action?
maya_fin: proposing provisional SLA credit because infra triggered autoscale/failover during a regional outage. Proposed provisional credit = $15,000 pending full recon (keeps $3,400 of the surge if usage stands).
devon_sales: Helios prefers a provisional credit and final reconcile after your audit. They agreed to a temporary hold on payment for the surge line. Legal ok on provisional memo.
lucy_billing: creating adjustment memo and attaching allocation CSV. Draft ADJ-2234: original_line surge_overage 18400 -> provisional_credit 15000, note: 'pending reclassification of failover usage to reserved commit'.
invoicer-bot: Adjustment ADJ-2234 created and queued for approval. Status: pending_approval. To approve run: `/approve ADJ-2234` in #finance.
devon_sales: include SLA_commit_id and ticket refs in the memo so Helios has audit trail.
maya_fin: infra ticket INF-5421 shows eu-west-3 GPU cluster rebooted, failover to us-east from 03:14-04:05 UTC. I'm pasting the ticket id here for records.
lucy_billing: uploaded allocation CSV to /billing/recon/helios/INV-2025-08-alloc.csv and linked in ADJ-2234. Adding notes and audit columns.
samops: pinging infra for KV cache and batching windows to confirm any wasted token billing during failover, will post logs. :thumbsup:
lucy_billing: ADJ-2234 now contains: audit_files:INV-2025-08-alloc.csv, infra_ticket:INF-5421, proposed_credit:15000. Routing to finance leads for sign-off.
invoicer-bot: ADJ-2234 approved_by:maya_fin status:processing. Invoice INV-2025-08 updated with provisional credit 15000 (final reconciliation pending tag reclassification).
